name: Measurement of Cosmic Microwave Background Polarization Power Spectra from Two Years of BICEP Data

official_url.quote: Measurement of Cosmic Microwave Background Polarization Power Spectra from Two Years of BICEP Data

summary.plain: From two years of data BICEP1 measured the E-mode polarization of the Big Bang afterglow precisely and found the B-mode spectrum consistent with zero, giving the first meaningful limit on gravitational waves from inflation using CMB B modes directly.
summary.technical: BICEP1 2006-2007 subset (~2% of sky): E-mode spectrum at 21 < l < 335 with high precision; B modes consistent with zero; r < 0.72 (95%). The three-year data set later gave r < 0.65 (BICEP2 paper).

title: Measurement of Cosmic Microwave Background Polarization Power Spectra from Two Years of BICEP Data
